In June 2024, the Corporation reported positive topline 8-week clinical data from its MAvERIC-Phase II study and in November 2024, the Corporation reported comprehensive MAvERIC-Phase II study results concurrent with the American Heart Association Scientific Sessions 2024.

In August 2025, the Corporation announced topline results from the ARCHER trial, which completed with 109 enrolled patients at leading cardiovascular research centers in the United States, France, Brazil, and Israel.
